text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is going to be featured
in a
magazine about racewear. I
accompany her to the
interview, but
when we arrive...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Your signature racewear is even
more
strikingly adorable up close! Okay,
let's try a
cutesy pose!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Cutesy... Like the efflorescent breeze.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Does your racewear have a flower motif?
It's so
light and gentle—it suits you
perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is the wind. It represents that which
I love,
and wish to become.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the wind! I see! Yes, it really does
give off the
impression of a nice, gentle
breeze!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The look in Yamanin Zephyr's eyes
suggests that
she's acknowledging the
reporter's interpretation,
but not
agreeing with it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I watch the photo shoot, I think back
to when
she decided on that racewear
design.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I have to decide on a motif?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hopes and dreams... Mine concern the
wind.
choice_data_list: A lot of girls pour their hopes and ideals into it, but...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A pure and vivid wind that blows on
forever and
free, akin to the one I
bathed in during a race I
once saw.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I wish to be like the gale that swept my
heart
away with such strength and
speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Returning to the place where Yamanin
Zephyr
found her inspiration might give
her a clearer idea
of how to design her
signature racewear.
choice_data_list: Then let's go visit that racetrack!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I close my eyes and listen closely... the
wind and
the sights from that day come
back to me in vivid
detail.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I remember how the folds of her dress
flapped
freely in the wind, how I
watched her ribbon
flutter. My heart
danced like the morning breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This wind...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. A gallant gale is blowing here,
just the
same as it did back then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My dreams, too... They're blowing
through my
heart again, as they did
before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
An unchanging desire, an unwavering
breeze... I
believe that's the wind my
signature racewear
should represent.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...So do I.
choice_data_list: It looks like it'll be a wonderful racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Remembering that proud smile of hers, I
find
myself compelled to intervene and
ensure that
her intentions are conveyed
properly before the
shoot ends.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh?
choice_data_list: Let's show them how you run, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her wind is stronger, faster, and more
captivating
than the interviewer seems
to think.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Zephyr is far more than just a gentle breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You always embrace my wind head-on,
and feel it
for what it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-this is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr! I know you must be busy, but is
it
possible we could redo our photo
shoot?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I think I misunderstood what you're
about. Your
wind, it's...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Too fierce to be called a gentle
breeze."
Curious...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... But I'm going to become a wind
that's even
stronger and grander than I
am now.
choice_data_list: Looks like they've come to understand your wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'll be a wind that runs freely wherever it
wishes,
so that someday I can reach the
heights I dream
of.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just like the wind that swept my heart
away in
that moment... With this
racewear, I will run like
the tempest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-this is unbelievable!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr! I know you must be busy, but is
it
possible we could redo our photo
shoot?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I think I misunderstood what you're
about. Your
wind, it's...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Too fierce to be called a gentle
breeze."
Curious...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this means I'm getting closer to
the wind I
felt that day... If so, then what
a radiant breeze.
choice_data_list: Looks like your wind reached their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at her own awe-inspiring figure in
the
magazine, Yamanin Zephyr looks
proud.
